resources.string: The smallest and fastest in the catalog — great for trying out chat on any device.
Balance of speed and response quality, a good default for mid-range devices.
More capable than the smaller Qwen versions, still lightweight.
Google\'s model, good general performance and Spanish support.
Meta\'s official model, long context (128K), built for small devices.
The largest in the catalog — better response quality, ask for more RAM and storage.
Meta\'s reference model at 8B, 128K context, good quality/size balance.
7B version of Qwen2.5, better reasoning than the smaller ones in the catalog.
Qwen2.5 variant specialized in code, large size for complex tasks.
Mistral AI\'s classic model, reliable for general-purpose chat.
Mistral AI + NVIDIA collaboration, long context (128K), 12B.
Larger version of Gemma 2 — better reasoning, needs more RAM than the 2B.
Newer Gemma generation — better overall quality than Gemma 2 at a similar size.
Latest Qwen generation, reasoning improvements over Qwen2.5 at a similar size.
8B version of Qwen3 — better quality, needs more RAM than the 4B.
DeepSeek\'s reasoning (chain-of-thought) model, distilled down to a small size.
7B version of DeepSeek\'s reasoning model — more elaborate step-by-step responses.
Meta\'s official multimodal model — understands images as well as text.
The most widely used vision model on Ollama — describes/analyzes images in the conversation.
Small, fast vision model — describes images with low RAM usage.
OpenBMB\'s vision model, good at OCR and detailed image descriptions.
Lightweight models already tested — tap \"Download\", no need to type the name by hand.
⚠ May not fit in RAM (needs ~%1$sGB, device has ~%2$sGB total)
Delete \"%1$s\"? This action can\'t be undone.
The download may take several minutes depending on the model\'s size.
